tasting_notes: Smooth and juicy with blueberry, blackcurrant, prune, floral notes, spice, and pencil shavings, this 62% Cabernet Sauvignon, 38% Merlot blend from Saint-Julien has a very lifted aromatic nose and a smooth medium-long finish. It pairs well with steak, pasta with red sauce, lasagna, and blue cheese. Rated 7 out of 10.

Juicy and jammy with dark cherry, plum, blackcurrant, blackberry, cedar, tobacco, and spice, this Pauillac is a young wine aged 9 months in French oak that benefits from extra time in the bottle. It pairs well with steak, filet mignon, blue cheese sauce, beef stroganoff, and pork tenderloin. Rated 8 out of 10 and chosen as the preferred finish wine over the Saint-Julien.
